data.title: Champions League Predictions - All Nine Wednesday games
data.content:
## Team news

Slovan Bratislava boss Yaya Toure has a fully-fit squad to choose from on Wednesday night.

Stuttgart have no fewer than six players ruled out, but they are hopeful that Jeff Chabot and Nikolas Nartey can return to action.

## Need to know

Slovan were beaten 6-1 at PSG in their first game, but they have strung together a solid run of domestic results since then. [...] Both teams have scored in nine of Slovan Bratislava’s last 10 games
 BTTS has also landed in five of Slovan’s seven Champions League matches this season, including qualifiers
 Stuttgart are yet to draw this season, winning four and losing three of their first seven games
 The hosts lost all eight league-phase games in their last Champions League campaign

Recommended bet: Stuttgart to win and both teams to score (93/100 with LiveScore Bet)

## Team news [...] The hosts lost all eight of their league-phase matches at this level in 2024/25, including a 3-1 home defeat to Stuttgart. The hosts won by that scoreline against Viking in their opener, and they can claim another comprehensive victory.

Score prediction: Slovan Bratislava 1-4 Stuttgart (11/1 with LiveScore Bet)
